schema: functions: name -> file, orig, size_orig, status (open, exact), kind, callers, note (by hand: an odd source form, a guessed name, dead code).

main.note: From Plexus ps.c: -k kcore (memf = coref = optarg) new, the cases s and c gone from the switch (s: and c: stay in the getopt string), Nproc (sizeof int) read before swplo.

prcom.note: odd forms: ctob((long)(char *)USIZE): the pointer cast keeps 10L<<8 from being folded (host/OLDCC.md, v1, folding); the pointer to the arguments as (long)argp & 0xffff (the offset), read from the last word of the user stack, its segment word with the bytes swapped (SWAP, a union); -k: a user block of a swapped process is zeroed, not read. The register variables ip, cp, cp1 only (tp, ttyp, str: autos).

access.note: odd: two unused locals (int *word = 0 of Plexus, and a char * whose name is guessed: wp); returns 1 instead of the word read.

within.note: bug kept: the bounds are declared pos (unsigned) but the callers pass longs (map b1/e1): the callee takes the low word of the lower bound and its high word as the upper bound.

l_lseek.note: odd form: -k: return after a good kvseek, the error falls into the lseek part (no else).

przom.note: odd: the state letters through a local char *stat = "OSWRIZT" declared last.

nothing.note: dead code, name guessed: an empty function behind przom (a ret).

getmmu.note: kva.c by sccvk (the compiler of the kernel objects): its MMU table is read once (mmuok).

kvtop.note: register order seg, attr, off, base (sccvk gives seg r1).

kvseek.note: bug kept: tests getmmu() == -1, but getmmu returns 0 on an error: an unreadable table is not reported here (kvtop then answers -1 for every address, mmuok being 0).

kpseek.note: odd form: return(lseek(fd, kptop(addr), 0)): the nested call leaves its temporary in the frame.
